newsitem.title: USA: Dow nudges higher at open, Nasdaq rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Dow nudges higher at open, Nasdaq rebounds.

text.p: U.S. stocks rose at the market open on Thursday, with the Nasdaq composite pulling higher as recently-bruised technology stocks staged a comeback.
The Dow Jones industrial average was trading up around six points at 7275 while Nasdaq was up around eight points or 0.57 percent at 1387.
Large technology stocks like Intel Corp, Dell Computer Corp and Microsoft Corp were higher. The technology sector has been battered by concerns about earnings and personal computer demand.
The long bond was off 4/32 at 6.89 percent.
